registration_timing: Post-candidate and post-candidate-holdout; random choices are deterministic and outcome-independent, but this is not a pristine untouched-holdout comparison.

budget_rule.eligible_rule: two groups; unseen pair; abs(pair MAC - candidate MAC) <= 0.02; pair MAC <= 0.25

primary_random_control_test.candidate_pass_rule: candidate net_rescue_rate >= 1.20 * mean(random control net_rescue_rate); if random mean <= 0, candidate must be positive and exceed the mean by at least 0.05
guardrails: candidate net_rescue_rate beats at least two of three random controls
primary_random_control_test.risk_weighted_metric_status: EXPLORATORY_ONLY: target-risk weights were not frozen before observing module results, so they cannot be the primary confirmatory control metric in Gate 0.

supervised_accuracy_sensitivity_baseline.definition: Rank groups by the total number of Selection FP32 hits degraded by q_only:Gj; break ties by group id; greedily add groups while cumulative MAC <= 0.25.
supervised_accuracy_sensitivity_baseline.interpretation: COLLISION: this conventional label-using sensitivity baseline selects G1+G5 too, so current evidence cannot establish that the RAMP-Q selector itself is novel.

label_free_output_reconstruction_baselin.data_source: the image list already frozen in artifacts/calibration/screen.json
label_free_output_reconstruction_baselin.model_output: raw detector output before confidence filtering and NMS
label_free_output_reconstruction_baselin.primary_score: mean over images of sum((raw_q_only - raw_fp32)^2) / (sum(raw_fp32^2) + 1e-12)
label_free_output_reconstruction_baselin.secondary_score: mean cosine distance; used only as a diagnostic, not to change the primary ranking
label_free_output_reconstruction_baselin.pair_selection: Among pairs satisfying the same budget rule, choose the pair with maximum sum of the two individual primary scores; tie-break by lower MAC, then lexicographic group ids.
label_free_output_reconstruction_baselin.anti_leakage: Freeze code and scores before reading any new random-pair q_only/r_only detection results.

execution_order: Compute and freeze the label-free output-reconstruction ranking.
Summarize all controls without changing pairs or thresholds.
novelty_status: NOVELTY_COLLISION_RISK: the mechanism signal is feasible, but selection-method novelty is not demonstrated because the supervised accuracy-sensitivity baseline returns the same pair.
evidence_boundary: RUOD-R Selection and PyTorch Q/DQ simulated W8A8 only. No new inference is performed by this script; no TensorRT, Jetson, latency, energy, VisDrone, or SOTA claim.
